gen-comfortaa-gf-ysabeau-sc: Friendly geometric rounds lead in Comfortaa, every stroke drawn like neon tubing with no hairlines to vanish. And Ysabeau SC keeps a gaping c at any size, so paragraphs move along in a modern, steady hum.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans reads approachable and open-ended on every curve, sitting beneath Comfortaa's headings, which carry the weight of drawn wire. Nudge the body size up a notch for comfort.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Comfortaa draws a wide-open ring of a c, bright as neon tubing. Zalando Sans Expanded takes over with clean, contemporary letters spaced wide, so paragraphs stretch out in a sparse, unhurried row.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpand: Modern from top to bottom, Comfortaa holds a constant-width trace like a laser-etched line. And Zalando Sans SemiExpanded brings open-mouthed curves, the standout quality here, in a professional voice.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa draws its curves with no stress at all. But ZCOOL XiaoWei does the softer work, a gentle modulation like hand-drawn ink lines that Comfortaa never attempts.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Round, bright, neon-simple: that's Comfortaa up top. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique below keeps a smooth path around each bend and a t with crossbar and stem matched, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Approachable and plain-spoken, the body text keeps its open curves clear, with no hairlines and no swells. Zen Kaku Gothic New gives Comfortaa's neon-ring headings a quiet partner, sans-serif and unfussy.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Zen Maru Gothic reads like following a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl, under Comfortaa's friendly rounds. Whole paragraphs would glide along, contemporary and unbroken from start to finish.
gen-dafont-aaargh-fs-amulya: Blunt, strong, and with no quill-like tapering anywhere. Aaargh commands with bowls and stems of matching weight, while Amulya keeps its curves generous and modern for the quieter text.
gen-dafont-aaargh-fs-asap: Aaargh sets bar thickness identical across the line and enters the e's eye generously, with moderate lowercase height. Asap does the readable work, its lowercase rising nearly to cap height.
